0x004A22D0: actor_record+0x64 flag must be non-zero to build the move table; move table grows from actor_record+0x70 and is filled up to actor_record+0x68 entries.
0x004A4900: setup is skipped when dword_8AB6E4 == 2; runs when *this == dword_7C54E8 (local player container) or dword_7CF884 >= 3.
0x004A24D0 / 0x004A2A40: input strings are NUL-terminated; quote-strip copies only bytes differing from 0x22.
0x004A5F20: pit-exit path fires only once per transition because it clears container+0x180.
postconditions: 0x004A2A90: on success sets pitcrew_animation+0x00 = 1, stores actor array at +0x10 with count at +0x0C; each actor's +0x74 move array is populated and its +0x4C..0x60 position/rotation loaded.

0x004A29A0: frees actor array (FreeWrapper_7bcf) and sound source at +0x14 (F_3DSoundSourceDestructor when dword_8AFE88 set); zeroes +0x00/+0x04/+0x08/+0x0C/+0x10/+0x14.
0x004A4900: allocates two 24-byte pitcrew_animation objects (PITCREWNORMAL, PITCREW10SEC) and a 136-byte pit_director (PITDIRECTOR), wired into container +0x0C/+0x10/+0x14.
0x004A5E60: sets container+0x180 byte to 1 and +0x184 to 4; 0x004A5E80 clears both to 0. 0x004A5F20 clears +0x180 once and increments car+0x4034+56.

side_effects: 0x004A2A90 parses an actor token stream (ACTOR/DETAIL/MESH/POSITION/MOVE/ROTATE) line by line via FileReadUntilNewline, allocates 120*count+4 bytes, builds actor records, and loads per-wheel meshes.

0x004A2A90 calls sub_4A22D0 to fill each actor's move table, appends the result to a global actor list via ActorNodeLinkedListAppend, and runs ConditionalDelegateDispatch(dword_7C54E8,...) before sub_4A3320.
0x004A2770 stores mode byte at actor_record+0x02 and value at +0x48, then loads a mesh via PitCrewMeshLoader and clears a global flag field via FlagFieldBitManipulation.

0x004A35F0 and 0x004A3820 per-frame update loops walk actor records (stride 120, count at +0x0C, array at +0x10) and call RangeProportionInitializer on each 28-byte move record using move_record+0x0C/+0x10 and the channel index at +0x18.
0x004A3440 sets Bit12 flags on actors whose +0x64 flag is set and clears the container flag word *this &= ~3.

0x004A3B50 is a camera update: calls the internal render wrapper with global dword_7C54E8, uses shake table flt_8AB274 indexed by dword_8AAE70, and collides the view with the spatial grid (dbl_7C9360).
0x004A51C0 loads tire/wheel graphics meshes from a data stream, using a per-difficulty delay (dword_7CF884 switch: 3/2/1/0), and dispatches each actor via TireWheelGraphicsMeshLoader.

0x004A4900 opens MAS archives (team.mas, pits.mas, cdb.mas, cmaps.mas via sub_53CBC0), builds PITCREW10SEC/PITCREWNORMAL/PITDIRECTOR asset names from car+0x4894, and tears archive handles down with PhysicsObjectLinkedListRemoval.

0x004A5F20, on a set container+0x180, notifies state change, increments car+0x4034+56, calls AIFormationLap, and may post an exiting-pits disqualification message when dword_8ACFD4==2 and dword_7C56A4==7.
0x004A7010 stores the given pair a3/a4 into container+0x0C/+0x10/+0x14/+0x18 and dispatches to 0x004A1B70; standalone helper, no pitcrew field writes confirmed.
0x004A22D0 / 0x004A29A0 / 0x004A4DB0 allocate and free heap blocks through OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper / FreeWrapper_7bcf wrappers.

disputes.description: 0x004A3320 reads this+0x14 and writes this+0x08, but its call site inside 0x004A2A90 passes a stack buffer declared as _BYTE v42[12]. Either the buffer is larger than the 12-byte declaration suggests (filled by ConditionalDelegateDispatch) or 0x004A3320 operates on a different object; unresolved without a caller-side stack/type review.

unresolved: Object and field names (pitcrew_animation, actor_record, move_record, pit_director, pitcrew_container) are provisional DERIVED labels from offset-pattern agreement; raw C contains no type declarations.

0x004A2980 calls ArrayResourceCleanup() with no explicit argument in the raw C; assumed to be an implicit-thiscall cleanup of the same object. If it targets a different object, the constructor/destructor ownership split changes.

0x004A35F0/0x004A3820 iterate records at actor_record+0x70/+0x74 which agree with the move table built by 0x004A22D0, but the identity is inferred from offset agreement only (rule 9: shared offsets do not prove shared type).
0x004A24D0 is decompiled as __thiscall but uses no this field; it behaves like a one-argument free function mapping an animation name to an index 0..24. Convention is ambiguous.
0x004A7010 appears unrelated to the pitcrew cluster (stores a3/a4 pairs into +0x0C..+0x18 then calls 0x004A1B70); its owning object and subsystem connection are unknown.
External boundaries for F_3DSoundSourceDestructor (Miles) and the render call behind dword_7C54E8 (DirectX) are inferred from names and structure only; not verified at STATIC_DERIVED tier.
dword_7CF884 is consumed as a 0..3 switch in 0x004A51C0 and compared against 2/3 elsewhere; exact meaning (difficulty/car-count/graphics level) is not established.
The camera math in 0x004A3B50 (constants 3.6, 2.75, 0.05, shake table flt_8AB274, spatial-grid collision) is recorded as observed structure, not fully derived behavior.
